cases.description: We need a Python developer with SQL and Django experience.
Candidates should know JavaScript, React, and REST APIs.
Experience with C language and C++ is preferred.
The candidate should have strong communication skills and problem-solving ability.
Build machine learning models using scikit-learn and TensorFlow.
Build a JAVA SCRIPT application with ReactJS and Mongo DB.
Use FAST API, NODEJS, and PostgreSQL.
Solve problem-solving tasks, troubleshoot issues, and perform code reviews.
The team will communicate with Pythonista developers working on team-oriented projects.
Experience in continuous integration and continuous deployment is preferred.
